strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Isoftwe yabathengisi nokuthengisa ngeveni
strings.tierB.home.description: Isoftwe yabasasazi: ii-invoyisi neerisithi kwifowuni yomthengisi, isitokhwe seveni, iintlawulo, iindlela notyelelo. Isebenza ngaphandle kwe-intanethi.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Lawula abathengisi bakho ukusuka kutyelelo lokuqala ukuya kwintlawulo yokugqibela
strings.tierB.home.definition: I-FieldSales liqonga le-cloud leenkampani zokusasaza nezithengisa ngobuninzi ezinabathengisi abatyelela abathengi. Abathengisi bakhupha baze baprinte ii-invoyisi neerisithi kwifowuni yabo, balandelela isitokhwe seveni kwaye babhala utyelelo, ngelixa abaphathi bebona intengiso, iintlawulo eziqokelelweyo neebhalansi zabathengi ngoko nangoko.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Ii-invoyisi kwifowuni yomthengisi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Umthengisi ukhupha i-invoyisi emnyango womthengi aze ayiprinte kwiprinta ye-thermal esebenza nge-Bluetooth phambi kokuba aphume evenkileni.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Iintlawulo neebhalansi zabathengi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Intlawulo nganye ifumana irisithi enenombolo enxulunyaniswe nee-invoyisi ezihlawulwayo, kwaye ibhalansi nesitatimenti somthengi zihlaziywa kwangoko.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Isitokhwe seveni esiphathwe ngumthengisi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Isitokhwe seveni nganye silandelelwa into ngento: esilayishiweyo, esithengisiweyo, esibuyisiweyo nesiseleyo, ngoko umahluko ubonakala ngolo suku.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Iindlela notyelelo
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Utyelelo lubhalwa nendawo, ixesha neefoto, kwaye indlela yomthengisi ngamnye izotywa kwimaphu ukuze umphathi ayibone.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Isebenza ngaphandle kwe-intanethi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Abathengisi baqhubeka bethengisa nokuba akukho nethiwekhi. Amaxwebhu alinda kwifowuni aze athunyelwe ngokuzenzekelayo, engaphindwanga, xa unxibelelwano lubuya.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Ideshibhodi yewebhu yabaphathi
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Intengiso, iintlawulo, iimpahla ezibuyisiweyo, isitokhwe nokusebenza kwabathengisi kwindawo enye, kunye neendima namalungelo omsebenzisi ngamnye.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Sixelele indlela othengisa ngayo
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Cela ikowuteshini okanye ubhukishe intlanganiso. Sijonga abathengisi bakho, iindlela, iimveliso neemfuno zakho zee-invoyisi.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Seta inkampani yakho
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Faka iimveliso, amaxabiso, abathengi nabathengisi, uze usete imali nezinga lerhafu lelizwe lakho kwiisetingi.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Thumela abathengisi ezindleleni
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Abathengisi bafaka i-app kwi-Android okanye kwi-iPhone, balayishe iveni yabo, baze baqalise ukuthengisa, ukuprinta nokuqokelela iintlawulo.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Landela usuku njengoko lusenzeka
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Ideshibhodi yewebhu ibonisa intengiso, iintlawulo, isitokhwe seeveni notyelelo ngelixa abathengisi besezindleleni.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: I-FieldSales liqonga le-cloud lokulawula abathengisi abatyelela abathengi kwiinkampani zokusasaza nezithengisa ngobuninzi. Ibandakanya ukuthengisa ngeveni (van sales), ukuthengisa kwiindlela ezimiselweyo (route sales), ukuthatha ii-odolo kwangaphambili (pre-sales) nokuhambisa ngqo kwiivenkile (DSD). Abathengisi bakhupha ii-invoyisi, baprinte, baqokelele iintlawulo baze babhale utyelelo kwifowuni yabo, kwaye abaphathi balandela intengiso, iintlawulo, isitokhwe seeveni neebhalansi zabathengi kwideshibhodi yewebhu.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Ewe. I-app yomthengisi iqhubeka isebenza ngaphandle kwe-intanethi: abathengisi bakhupha baze baprinte ii-invoyisi neerisithi, babhale utyelelo kwaye bongeze abathengi abatsha, kwaye yonke into ithunyelwa ngokuzenzekelayo ingaphindwanga xa unxibelelwano lubuya. Kukho okwahlukileyo okunye eSaudi Arabia: iinkampani ezivule unxibelelwano lwee-invoyisi ze-elektroniki zidinga unxibelelwano ngomzuzu wokukhupha i-invoyisi okanye imbuyekezo.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: I-FieldSales isebenzela iinkampani zokusasaza kuwo onke amazwe. Inkampani nganye iseta imali yayo nezinga layo lerhafu kwiisetingi zayo, kwaye ii-invoyisi, iirisithi neengxelo ziyazisebenzisa. I-FieldSales ngokwayo izinze eRiyadh, eSaudi Arabia, kwaye ukuqalisa kwenziwa nge-intanethi ngeentlanganiso, nge-WhatsApp nangoncedo olukude.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: Ingaba i-FieldSales iyaqhagamshela kwiinkqubo zikarhulumente zee-invoyisi ze-elektroniki?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Sixhasa unxibelelwano lweSigaba seSibini neqonga le-Fatoora le-ZATCA. Oku kusebenza kwiinkampani zaseSaudi Arabia. Kwamanye amazwe, i-FieldSales ikhupha ii-invoyisi ngemali yakho nezinga lakho lerhafu, kwaye unxibelelwano nenkqubo yesizwe yee-invoyisi ze-elektroniki (e-invoicing) lufumaneka xa lucelwa, emva kokuba sihlolisise iimfuno zelo lizwe kunye nawe. Ngaphandle kweSaudi Arabia asenzi sithembiso malunga nemithetho yasekuhlaleni.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: I-app ye-FieldSales ifumaneka kwezi lwimi kuphela: Isi-Arabhu, IsiNgesi, IsiFrentshi, Isi-Turkish, IsiMandarin. Ayifumaneki ngesiXhosa. Abathengisi nabaphathi banokutshintsha ulwimi lwe-app, kwaye ii-invoyisi eziprintiweyo zinokuba nolwimi lwesibini ecaleni kolwimi oluphambili. Amaphepha ewebhusayithi ngezinye iilwimi, njengeli phepha lesiXhosa, ziinguqulelo ezinika ulwazi ngemveliso.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Cela ikowuteshini, bhukisha intlanganiso okanye usithumelele umyalezo kwi-WhatsApp. Sifunda indlela abasebenza ngayo abathengisi bakho, emva koko sikuncede useke iimveliso, amaxabiso, abathengi nabathengisi. Abathengisi bafaka i-app kwi-Android okanye kwi-iPhone, kwaye abaphathi basebenzisa ideshibhodi yewebhu kuyo nayiphi na ibhrawuza. Ii-smartphone zizo kuphela izixhobo ozidingayo.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: I-app ye-FieldSales ifumaneka kwezi lwimi: Isi-Arabhu, IsiNgesi, IsiFrentshi, Isi-Turkish, IsiMandarin; ayifumaneki ngesiXhosa. Amaphepha ngezinye iilwimi achaza imveliso ukuze ufumane ulwazi kuphela.
strings.tierB.category.title: Isoftwe yokuthengisa ngeveni (van sales) | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Isoftwe yokuthengisa ngeveni (van sales): ii-invoyisi eziprintwa ngefowuni, isitokhwe seveni, iintlawulo notyelelo. Isebenza ngaphandle kwe-intanethi.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Isoftwe yokuthengisa ngeveni yabasasazi nabathengisi ngobuninzi
strings.tierB.category.intro: I-FieldSales yisoftwe yokuthengisa ngeveni yeenkampani ezinabathengisi abathengisa besuka eveni kwiindlela zemihla ngemihla. Umthengisi ulayisha iveni, athengise kwivenkile nganye, aprinte i-invoyisi, aqokelele intlawulo aze abhale iimpahla ezibuyisiweyo, konke kwi-app enye yefowuni. Umphathi ubona okulayishiweyo, okuthengisiweyo, okuqokelelweyo nokuseleyo kwiveni nganye.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Yintoni isoftwe yokuthengisa ngeveni?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Isoftwe yokuthengisa ngeveni, ekwabizwa ngokuba yisoftwe ye-route sales, iqhuba indlela yokuthengisa apho umthengisi ephethe isitokhwe esithuthini aze athengise, ahambise, akhuphe i-invoyisi aze aqokelele intlawulo kutyelelo olunye. Ithatha indawo yeencwadi zee-invoyisi zamaphepha neefowuni zasekupheleni kosuku. Ibhala yonke intengiso, intlawulo nembuyekezo njengoxwebhu, ngoko isitokhwe nemali zinokuthelekiswa ngolo suku. Kumphathi, iphendula imibuzo emithathu rhoqo ngokuhlwa: umthengisi ngamnye uthengise ntoni, uqokelele malini, kwaye kusele ntoni kwiveni nganye?
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Usuku ezindleleni
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Usuku luqala ngokulayisha okubhaliweyo ukusuka kwindawo yokugcina iimpahla ukuya eveni. Kwivenkile nganye umthengisi ukhetha umthengi kwi-app, ongeze iimpahla ngoluhlu okanye nge-barcode, akhuphe i-invoyisi aze ayiprinte kwiprinta ye-thermal. Intlawulo ibhalwa nerisithi, kwaye nayiphi na imbuyekezo ibhalwa nesizathu sayo. Ekupheleni kosuku, okuseleyo eveni kwehliselwa kwakhona kwindawo yokugcina iimpahla. Phakathi kwala manyathelo, umphathi unokulandela intengiso, iintlawulo notyelelo lomthengisi ngamnye kwideshibhodi yewebhu engakhange afowunele mntu.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Yakhelwe iindawo ezinenethiwekhi ebuthathaka
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Iindlela zokusasaza zidlula kwizakhiwo ezingaphantsi komhlaba, kwiindawo zemizi-mveliso nasemaphandleni apho inethiwekhi ibuthathaka. I-app yomthengisi ye-FieldSales igcina abathengi, iimveliso namaxabiso kwifowuni, ngoko umthengisi unokukhupha aze aprinte amaxwebhu ngaphandle kwe-intanethi. Uxwebhu ngalunye lunesitshixo esisodwa, ngoko lufika kanye kuphela, nokuba ukuthumela kuphindwe. Iinkampani zaseSaudi Arabia ezivule unxibelelwano lwee-invoyisi ze-elektroniki zidinga unxibelelwano ngomzuzu wokukhupha ii-invoyisi nembuyekezo. Iirisithi, utyelelo nabathengi abatsha basasebenza ngaphandle kwe-intanethi kwezo nkampani.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Iintlawulo nesitokhwe seveni
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Imali esendleleni idinga ulawulo olufanayo nolwesitokhwe. Intlawulo nganye ifumana irisithi enenombolo enokunxulunyaniswa nee-invoyisi ezihlawulwayo, kwaye ibhalansi yomthengi ihlaziywa kwangoko. Isitokhwe seveni sibalwa into ngento njengokulayishiweyo kuthabathe okuthengisiweyo, kongezwe imbuyekezo nolungiso olubhaliweyo, ngoko abaphathi banokusithelekisa nokubala okwenyani phambi kokuba umthengisi agoduke. Iimpahla ezibuyisiweyo zinokuhlelwa njengeziqhelekileyo, ezonakeleyo okanye ezitshintshiselwayo, kwaye umphathi ugqiba ukuba ziyabuyela na kwisitokhwe seveni esilungele ukuthengiswa.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Ilungele bani?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: I-FieldSales ilungele abasasazi nabathengisi ngobuninzi beempahla ezithengiswa ngokukhawuleza (FMCG) ezifana nokutya, iziselo, izinto zokucoca nezokuzinyamekela, kunye nayo nayiphi na inkampani enabathengisi abatyelela iivenkile, ii-spaza neevenkile zasezilokishini kwiindlela ezimiselweyo. Ixhasa ukuthengisa ngeveni, ii-odolo zangaphambili (pre-sales) nokuhambisa ngqo kwiivenkile (DSD). Ayiyo i-ERP epheleleyo: iqhagamshela kwinkqubo yakho ye-accounting okanye ye-ERP nge-API. Abaphathi balawula oko umthengisi ngamnye anokukwenza, njengokunika isaphulelo, ukuthengisa ngaphantsi kwexabiso eliseluhlwini okanye ukongeza abathengi abatsha.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Yintoni umahluko phakathi kokuthengisa ngeveni nokuthatha ii-odolo kwangaphambili (pre-sales)?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Ekuthengiseni ngeveni umthengisi uphethe isitokhwe aze ahambise, akhuphe i-invoyisi aze aqokelele intlawulo kutyelelo olunye. Kwi-pre-sales umthengisi uthatha i-odolo ehanjiswa yindawo yokugcina iimpahla kamva. I-FieldSales ixhasa zombini, ngoko inkampani inokusebenzisa iiveni kwezinye iindlela kwaye ithathe ii-odolo kwezinye. Kuzo zombini, ii-invoyisi, iintlawulo neebhalansi zabathengi zikwinkqubo enye, kwaye abaphathi bazibona kwiingxelo ezifanayo.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Ndisilinganisa njani isitokhwe seveni ekupheleni kosuku?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: I-FieldSales ibonisa, kwinto nganye kwiveni nganye, ubungakanani obulayishiweyo, obuthengisiweyo, obubuyisiweyo nobuseleyo. Thelekisa okuseleyo nokubala okwenyani, ubhale nawuphi na umahluko njengolungiso olubhaliweyo, uze wehlisele okuseleyo kwindawo yokugcina iimpahla ngentshukumo enye. Iveni iqala usuku olulandelayo nebhalansi ecocekileyo eyaziwayo.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Zeziphi izixhobo ezifunwa ngumthengisi othengisa ngeveni?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: I-smartphone, i-Android okanye i-iPhone. Iprinta ye-thermal esebenza nge-Bluetooth ayinyanzelekanga, kwaye inceda umthengisi anike umthengi i-invoyisi okanye irisithi eprintiweyo. I-FieldSales ayithengisi zixhobo kwaye ayifuni hlobo luthile lweprinta. Abaphathi basebenzisa ideshibhodi yewebhu kwibhrawuza yayo nayiphi na ikhompyutha okanye ifowuni.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: Ingaba i-FieldSales ingaqhagamshela kwinkqubo yethu ye-accounting?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Ewe. I-FieldSales inika i-API eyenza ukuba inkqubo yakho ye-accounting okanye ye-ERP itshintshiselane neqonga ngabathengi, iimveliso, ii-invoyisi, iirisithi neentshukumo zesitokhwe. Iqela lakho okanye umboneleli wakho we-IT wakha olu nxibelelwano esebenzisa amaxwebhu e-API.
strings.tierB.countries.title: I-FieldSales ngokwelizwe: imali, irhafu ne-e-invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: I-FieldSales isebenzela abasasazi kuwo onke amazwe. Bona imali, irhafu yokuthengisa nemeko ye-e-invoicing yelizwe ngalinye kwitheyibhile enye.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: I-FieldSales isebenzela iinkampani zokusasaza kuwo onke amazwe. Inkampani nganye ikhetha ilizwe layo, imali nezinga lerhafu kwiisetingi zayo, kwaye ii-invoyisi, iirisithi neengxelo ziyazilandela. Unxibelelwano lukarhulumente lwee-invoyisi ze-elektroniki lusebenza eSaudi Arabia kuphela. Kuwo onke amanye amazwe lufumaneka xa lucelwa. Itheyibhile engezantsi idwelisa, kwilizwe ngalinye, imali yasekhaya, izinga eliqhelekileyo lerhafu yokuthengisa okanye i-VAT, nokuba unxibelelwano lukarhulumente lwee-invoyisi ze-elektroniki luyasebenza okanye lufumaneka xa lucelwa.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Sixhasa unxibelelwano lweSigaba seSibini neqonga le-Fatoora le-ZATCA
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Imali nezinga lerhafu zisetwa yinkampani nganye kwiisetingi zayo. Amazinga akule theyibhile sisikhokelo esiqhelekileyo kwaye anokutshintsha; buza umcebisi wakho werhafu ngemithetho yangoku. Udeshi (—) uthetha ukuba akukho zinga liqhelekileyo lidwelisiweyo kwelo lizwe.
strings.tierB.about.title: Malunga ne-FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: I-FieldSales yakha isoftwe ye-cloud yeenkampani zokusasaza ezinabathengisi abatyelela abathengi. Yasekwa ngo-2026 eRiyadh, eSaudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: I-FieldSales (igama lesiArabhu: فيلد سيلز) liqonga le-cloud leenkampani zokusasaza nezithengisa ngobuninzi ezinabathengisi abatyelela abathengi. Inkampani yasekwa ngo-2026 kwaye izinze eRiyadh, eSaudi Arabia. Isebenzela iinkampani kuwo onke amazwe, kwaye imali nezinga lerhafu lelizwe ngalinye zisetwa kwiisetingi zenkampani ngokwayo. Abathengi bethu ziinkampani ezithengisa nezihambisa iimpahla ngabathengisi abasezindleleni: abasasazi, abathengisi ngobuninzi nabavelisi abaneeveni zabo abathengisa ngazo.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Sakha inkqubo enye edibeneyo yawo wonke umjikelo wasezindleleni: ii-invoyisi eziprintwa ngefowuni yomthengisi, iirisithi neebhalansi zabathengi, isitokhwe seveni esiphathwe ngumthengisi, iindlela notyelelo ngendawo neefoto, kunye nedeshibhodi yewebhu yabaphathi. I-app yomthengisi isebenza kwi-Android nakwi-iPhone kwaye iqhubeka isebenza ngaphandle kwe-intanethi, emva koko ihlaziye xa unxibelelwano lubuya. Iinkampani zinokuqhagamshela i-FieldSales kwinkqubo yazo ye-accounting okanye ye-ERP nge-API, ukuze idatha yasezindleleni ingachwethezwa kabini.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Sichaza imveliso njengoko injalo. Sixhasa unxibelelwano lweSigaba seSibini neqonga le-Fatoora le-ZATCA. Unxibelelwano neenkqubo zikarhulumente kwamanye amazwe lufumaneka xa lucelwa. I-app ifumaneka kwezi lwimi: Isi-Arabhu, IsiNgesi, IsiFrentshi, Isi-Turkish, IsiMandarin; ayifumaneki ngesiXhosa. Ukuze uthethe nathi, cela ikowuteshini, bhukisha intlanganiso okanye usithumelele umyalezo kwi-WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Qhagamshelana ne-FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Thetha neqela le-FieldSales: cela ikowuteshini, bhukisha intlanganiso okanye ncokola kwi-WhatsApp malunga nesoftwe yabathengisi neyokuthengisa ngeveni.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Sixelele indlela abathengisa ngayo abathengisi bakho namhlanje nento ofuna ukuyitshintsha. Cela ikowuteshini, bhukisha intlanganiso okanye usithumelele umyalezo kwi-WhatsApp, kwaye ilungu leqela lethu liya kuphendula. Iinkampani esele zisebenzisa i-FieldSales zinokusebenzisa kwezi ndlela zinye ukufumana uncedo. Kuyanceda ukuchaza ilizwe lakho, inani labathengisi nokuba bathengisa besuka eveni, bathatha ii-odolo okanye zombini.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Bhukisha intlanganiso ye-intanethi neqela lethu. Siza kukubonisa usuku lomthengisi kwi-app nedeshibhodi yomphathi, sisebenzisa imizekelo esondeleyo kwiimveliso zakho neendlela zakho, size siphendule imibuzo yakho malunga nokuseta.
